g.text: Recent evolution of equatorial stratospheric zonal winds

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: Positive winds indicate westerly (eastward) flow; negative winds indicate easterly (westward) flow.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657587

g.text: Each pressure level has an independent vertical scale. Values represent zonal winds, not anomalies.
